data.title: Unemployment benefit ends on 1 September 2026
data.summary: The Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen cancelled your unemployment benefit (Arbeitslosengeld) from 1 September 2026 because you start an insured job that day. It will still pay you €1,318.20 for August 2026.
data.explanation: Because you start a job subject to social insurance on 1 September 2026, your unemployment benefit stops from that day (§ 48 Abs. 1 SGB X). The remaining payment for August, €1,318.20, is still due to you. If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person for the record at the agency. It must reach the agency by the deadline shown in the app. If you agree, no action is needed, but check that the August payment arrives. A counselling service can help if you are unsure.

key_facts.quote: Die Bewilligung von Arbeitslosengeld wird deshalb ab diesem Tag aufgehoben (§ 48 Abs. 1 SGB X).

key_facts.quote: Für den August 2026 zahlen wir Ihnen noch 1.318,20 €.

key_facts.quote: Sie nehmen am 01.09.2026 eine versicherungspflichtige Beschäftigung auf.
